description: Prompt for troubleshooting a blocked ticket from inside the ticket variation's VM (the grouped engines, ASS-68): the root cause, learning from its earlier blocks, for the Classify step after it to route (ASS-107)

input-arguments.name: problem
input-arguments.description: The ticket's earlier blocks: each stay, what was found and tried, how it ended (- when none)

needs-fix.description: true if there is a real problem to fix

summary.description: The problem in one line, 120 characters or fewer

root-cause.description: The root cause, and the chain from it to the symptoms

evidence.description: What proves each claim: a command and its first error line, file:line, a log line; unchecked claims marked unverified

missing-repository.description: Only when the cause is a repository the project does not list, which the work needs: its forge url (https://github.com/<owner>/<repo> or https://gitlab.com/<group>/<repo>); left out otherwise (ASS-121)

failing-repository.description: Only when the cause is in the product's own code: the forge url of the repository whose check fails (ASS-163); left out otherwise

failing-job.description: Only then: the CI job that runs the failing check, as the project's CI names it (.gitlab-ci.yml, .github/workflows), for the harness to check on the latest master

failing-assertion.description: Only then: the failing test or assertion, or the command and its exit
